name: Warship Survival
detailed_description:
Man the helm and Dominate the Seas!

In this small arcade naval action game, you’ll face endless waves of increasingly challenging enemies across the open seas. Start with a humble torpedo boat and fight your way through to unlock various destroyers, battleships or even a hulking aircraft carrier, each with its own strengths and playstyle. Sink foes, survive as long as you can, and upgrade your ship to push further each run.

Every battle earns you experience. As you destroy enemies, your ship levels up, boosting its power mid-match. Once your run ends, you’ll spend earned points on permanent upgrades to improve your chances next time.

Engage in Tactical Warfare

  • Multiple ship types: torpedo boats, destroyers, frigates, aircraft carriers, and submarines

  • Replay-focused roguelike structure with random upgrades each run

  • Real-time naval combat with satisfying explosions and enemy waves

  • Upgrade your ship’s speed, firepower, health, and more after each battle

  • Endless mode with scaling difficulty

  • 2 different gamemodes

  • Prestige Mode

Upgrade, Adapt, and Conquer

Earn experience by sinking enemy ships and surviving the chaos. As you progress, transform your humble torpedo boat into a warship. Collect points for every second you stay afloat and invest them in upgrades, enhance your firepower, reinforce your hull, or boost your maneuverability to gain the upper hand.

Beware the Tower Islands

Not all threats roam the open sea. Tower islands stand as formidable guardians, ready to obliterate any ship that strays too close. Stay alert, plan your approach, and adapt your strategy because not every ship is built to face every enemy.

Become master of the seas!

Designed for quick, replayable sessions with steady progression, this is a naval game that’s easy to pick up, hard to master, and perfect for fans of light roguelikes and arcade-style action. The sea is ruthless. Do you have what it takes to survive?

Are you ready to set sail, Captain?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (4th Gen or higher) or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 470
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
